components.name: Active Task
components.description: A recessed panel entry naming a real running window.
components.css: .ds-active-task { background:#b8b4a5; color:#242724; padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid #d3d0c2; border-top-color:#6e6c64; border-left-color:#6e6c64; border-radius:0; font:700 12px monospace; } .ds-active-task:hover,.ds-active-task:focus-visible { outline:1px solid #4e5869; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Kernel Console
components.description: The movable kernel console inside one-pixel system chrome.
components.css: .ds-terminal { width:420px; border:1px solid #6e6c64; border-top-color:#d3d0c2; border-left-color:#d3d0c2; border-radius:0; background:#b8b4a5; color:#242724; font:14px monospace; padding:2px; } .ds-terminal header { background:#4e5869; color:#c9c8b5; padding:5px 7px; font-weight:700; cursor:move; } .ds-terminal pre { min-height:180px; margin:2px 0 0; padding:8px; background:#171a17; color:#c9c8b5; border:1px solid #6e6c64; } .ds-terminal:focus-within { outline:1px solid #4e5869; outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Utility Window
components.description: A retained system surface showing real kernel or filesystem state.
components.css: .ds-utility { width:320px; border:1px solid #6e6c64; border-top-color:#d3d0c2; border-left-color:#d3d0c2; border-radius:0; background:#b8b4a5; color:#242724; font:14px monospace; padding:2px; } .ds-utility header { background:#4e5869; color:#c9c8b5; padding:5px 7px; font-weight:700; cursor:move; } .ds-utility pre { min-height:120px; margin:2px 0 0; padding:8px; background:#171a17; color:#c9c8b5; border:1px solid #6e6c64; }

narrative.overview: ArgusOS feels like a maintained workstation in a dim room: practical, slightly severe, and built for legibility. Restrained color, economical layout, and one-pixel chrome support the work without turning an era reference into product identity.
keyCharacteristics: Muted olive field with warm gray system chrome
Square corners and crisp one-pixel bevels
Small bitmap type with compact labels
Only real windows, actions, and state labels

rules.name: The Dust Rule
rules.body: No fully saturated color appears anywhere. Accent color stays under ten percent of a screen and always communicates state.

rules.name: The Integer Pixel Rule
rules.body: Glyphs are scaled only by whole numbers and never smoothed, stretched, or shadowed.

rules.name: The One-Pixel Bevel Rule
rules.body: Every raised or recessed edge uses exactly one highlight and one shadow line. Never stack ornamental borders.

dos: Do use #4c5148 as the dominant field and #b8b4a5 for system chrome.
Do use square corners and exact one-pixel highlight/shadow edges.
Do name only real surfaces, actions, and system state.
Do keep the terminal readable with #c9c8b5 on #171a17.
Do preserve keyboard and serial access for every important action.
Do use the same focus, dragging, and content-inset behavior for every window.
donts: Don't make ArgusOS a glossy Windows XP clone or a literal imageboard clone.
Don't use era labels, copied artwork, fake system state, or nonfunctional chrome.
Don't use neon cyberpunk accents, gradients, glassmorphism, or rounded cards.
Don't use a colored side stripe on any panel or item.
Don't animate anything that does not communicate a state change.
Don't add close, resize, or launch controls before those actions work.
